name: Coupler.io
summary: Coupler.io is a data integration platform. Its MCP server lets your AI query Search Console data that a Coupler.io data flow has imported.
signIn: Connect Google Search Console in a Coupler.io data flow, then add an AI tool as the destination. Access uses a personal access token generated in the Coupler.io web app. The Custom MCP destination gives an MCP server URL and a generated token.
tools: No count stated. Its MCP docs list 24 tool names.
dataSources: Google Search Console: Search Results Performance (clicks, impressions, CTR, position)
Google Search Console: Performance by Appearance (Video, Image, AMP results)
Google Search Console: Google News Performance
Google Search Console: URL Inspection Data
Google Search Console: Page Index Performance
400+ other Coupler.io data sources, such as Google Analytics 4, Google Ads and HubSpot (the MCP page FAQ says over 70)
free: A Free plan at $0 forever: 1 account, 1 user, 1 data source, 1 destination, manual refresh, 100 rows per data flow run. New accounts get 7 free days with Pro plan limits. The MCP page says MCP needs at least the Professional plan, a name that does not appear on the pricing page.
price: Starter $32 per month, or $24 per month billed annually. Active $132 per month, or $99 per month billed annually. Pro $259 per month, or $199 per month billed annually. Custom is priced by sales. Prices in USD.
writeActions: No Google Search Console write actions stated. Data queries are read only. The AI can change Coupler.io configuration: create data flows, add sources and destinations, change schedules, build SQL data sets and trigger a run.
dataStorage: Data is imported into Coupler.io data sets by data flows, and SQL queries run on Coupler.io's side. Coupler.io says the data is never used for AI model training.
pickIf: You already move marketing data through Coupler.io and want to ask about it in chat.
You want Search Console next to over 400 other sources, queried with SQL on Coupler.io's side.
You want saved business context that later conversations reuse.
